item.title: Top Tips for Preventing Blackheads - Just Nadiene
item.description: Blackheads are clogged open pores caused by excess sebum and dead skin. They are often mistaken for dirt due to oxidation. Proper care includes cleansing twice daily with gentle products, regular exfoliation with BHAs, and tailored treatments like clay masks and retinoids. Maintaining hydration and avoiding heavy makeup helps prevent future occurrences.
